name: Horizon
description: A synthwave dashboard: neon HUD panels over a dusk sky, a striped setting sun and a grid floor that runs to the horizon. Pages are tuned like a car radio from a dashboard strip; car pages read like an instrument cluster with gauges, trip counters and warning lights. Works from a phone to a native 4K screen, with an Interface size setting. Runs on /api/v1.
author: Sentry Mate
